title: Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract Summary of Rental, Towing, Trip Interruption, Roadside and Key Benefits
content:
Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract plans carry benefits beside the repair itself: rental car reimbursement while a covered repair is performed, towing after a covered breakdown, lodging and meals when a covered breakdown happens far from home, 24-hour roadside assistance, and reimbursement for a lost or damaged smart key.

## Rental and towing

| Plan | Rental reimbursement per day (USD) | Maximum rental days per covered repair visit | Towing per covered breakdown (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Powertrain | 35.00 | 5 | 100.00 |
| Kestrel Care Gold | 40.00 | 5 | 100.00 |
| Kestrel Care Gold Plus | 45.00 | 7 | 125.00 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum | 50.00 | 7 | 150.00 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Plus | 55.00 | 10 | 150.00 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Elite | 65.00 | 10 | 200.00 |

## Trip interruption, roadside assistance and smart key

| Plan | Trip interruption per day (USD) | Maximum trip interruption days per breakdown | Minimum distance from home (miles) | 24-hour roadside assistance | Smart key replacement per term (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Powertrain | 0.00 | 0 | 100 | Included | 0.00 (not covered) |
| Kestrel Care Gold | 100.00 | 3 | 100 | Included | 0.00 (not covered) |
| Kestrel Care Gold Plus | 100.00 | 3 | 100 | Included | 0.00 (not covered) |
| Kestrel Care Platinum | 125.00 | 3 | 100 | Included | 400.00 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Plus | 150.00 | 5 | 100 | Included | 400.00 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Elite | 200.00 | 5 | 100 | Included | 800.00 |

## Notes

- Trip interruption reimburses lodging and meals per day; on Kestrel Care Powertrain the daily figure and the day count are both zero, so that plan carries no trip interruption amount.
- A smart key figure of 0.00 means smart key replacement is not covered on that plan; the figure on the other plans is a reimbursement limit for the whole term.
- The rental day count is per covered repair visit; the trip interruption day count is per breakdown.
